facts.text: Its eerie blue-green glow, caused by its sun, also added to the strangeness of the world.

evidence.quote: Its eerie blue-green glow, caused by its sun, also added to the strangeness of the world.

facts.text: Despite this outward appearance, however, Emperor Palpatine's dark-side energies were everywhere, corrupting not only the inhabitants, but the planet itself.

evidence.quote: Despite this outward appearance, however, Emperor Palpatine's dark-side energies were everywhere, corrupting not only the inhabitants, but the planet itself.

facts.text: Byss was a secret throne world of the Emperor and the location of his towering citadel and his secret supply of clone bodies there.

evidence.quote: Byss was a secret throne world of the Emperor and the location of his towering citadel and his secret supply of clone bodies there.

facts.text: Byss was also a redoubt for the Galactic Empire due to its location being almost impossible to reach safely through hyperspace, due to the high density of stars.

evidence.quote: Byss was also a redoubt for the Galactic Empire due to its location being almost impossible to reach safely through hyperspace, due to the high density of stars.

facts.text: The planet was orbited by five small moons, which had little influence on its tides.

evidence.quote: The planet was orbited by five small moons, which had little influence on its tides.

facts.text: Bathed in a blue-green sunlight, Byss was originally a lush and fertile world.

evidence.quote: Bathed in a blue-green sunlight, Byss was originally a lush and fertile world.

facts.text: Byss was renowned throughout planets under the control of the Galactic Empire as a legendary world of serene, paradisaical natural beauty.

evidence.quote: Byss was renowned throughout planets under the control of the Galactic Empire as a legendary world of serene, paradisaical natural beauty.

facts.text: The planet was dotted with chains of lakes and rivers where microscopic lifeforms dwelled, as well as wind-smoothed plateaus and canyons.

evidence.quote: The planet was dotted with chains of lakes and rivers where microscopic lifeforms dwelled, as well as wind-smoothed plateaus and canyons.

facts.text: Its isolation from much of the galaxy allowed for its natural islands and pre–Expansionist Era ruins to remain untouched for thousands of years.

evidence.quote: Its isolation from much of the galaxy allowed for its natural islands and pre–Expansionist Era ruins to remain untouched for thousands of years.

facts.text: Most of Byss's vegetation was ferns and lichens.

evidence.quote: Most of Byss's vegetation was ferns and lichens.

facts.text: No intelligent species ever evolved on Byss, and what wildlife there existed was largely nocturnal and harmless.

evidence.quote: No intelligent species ever evolved on Byss, and what wildlife there existed was largely nocturnal and harmless.

facts.text: The planet's calm, balmy climate and mild seasons, ranging from clear to rainy, were primarily caused by its minuscule axial tilt and stable geologic foundation.

evidence.quote: The planet's calm, balmy climate and mild seasons, ranging from clear to rainy, were primarily caused by its minuscule axial tilt and stable geologic foundation.

facts.text: Violent phenomena, such as storms and volcanism, were extremely rare.

evidence.quote: Violent phenomena, such as storms and volcanism, were extremely rare.

facts.text: This led to the creation of a myth, fabricated by the Empire, concerning a beautiful and mystic siren world hidden from the galaxy at large, where blissful contentment awaited any who chose to apply for immigration to the planet.

evidence.quote: This led to the creation of a myth, fabricated by the Empire, concerning a beautiful and mystic siren world hidden from the galaxy at large, where blissful contentment awaited any who chose to apply for immigration to the planet.

facts.text: Politically, Byss was ruled by three major galactic powers.

evidence.quote: Politically, Byss was ruled by three major galactic powers.

facts.text: The planet was controlled by the Rakatan Infinite Empire for nearly five-thousand years before its collapse, and thousands of years later the planet came under the rule of the Galactic Empire, where it served as Emperor Palpatine's resort world.

evidence.quote: The planet was controlled by the Rakatan Infinite Empire for nearly five-thousand years before its collapse, and thousands of years later the planet came under the rule of the Galactic Empire, where it served as Emperor Palpatine's resort world.

facts.text: A towering citadel was built using non-Human slave labor at the heart of the ruling city, along with ornate buildings and resort complexes, and soon an entire continent, the Imperial control sector, was covered in a cityscape.

evidence.quote: A towering citadel was built using non-Human slave labor at the heart of the ruling city, along with ornate buildings and resort complexes, and soon an entire continent, the Imperial control sector, was covered in a cityscape.

facts.text: The planet was ruled as a dark-side theocracy, led solely by Palpatine and his Dark Side Adepts.

evidence.quote: The planet was ruled as a dark-side theocracy, led solely by Palpatine and his Dark Side Adepts.

facts.text: Byss became one of Palpatine's fortress worlds after the Empire's collapse at Endor, and served as the capital world of the Dark Empire, his reborn empire.

evidence.quote: Byss became one of Palpatine's fortress worlds after the Empire's collapse at Endor, and served as the capital world of the Dark Empire, his reborn empire.

facts.text: At this point, the planet became a rallying point for the remaining fragments of the former Empire and the base of operations for Palpatine's reconquest of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: At this point, the planet became a rallying point for the remaining fragments of the former Empire and the base of operations for Palpatine's reconquest of the galaxy.

facts.text: It also became the construction site of numerous Imperial superweapons, including the World Devastators, the Sovereign-class and Eclipse-class dreadnoughts, and the Galaxy Gun.

evidence.quote: It also became the construction site of numerous Imperial superweapons, including the World Devastators, the Sovereign-class and Eclipse-class dreadnoughts, and the Galaxy Gun.

facts.text: After its destruction, the Imperial Remnant remained active in the Beshqek system and patrolled Byss's remains.

evidence.quote: After its destruction, the Imperial Remnant remained active in the Beshqek system and patrolled Byss's remains.

facts.text: Under Imperial rule, Byss became one of the most reclusive and heavily guarded worlds in the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Under Imperial rule, Byss became one of the most reclusive and heavily guarded worlds in the galaxy.

facts.text: Most natural routes into the Deep Core were mined and the rest were covered by the Imperial Hyperspace Security Net—a system of gravity well projectors and hyperwave transceivers designed to monitor and control traffic into and out of the Deep Core.

evidence.quote: Most natural routes into the Deep Core were mined and the rest were covered by the Imperial Hyperspace Security Net—a system of gravity well projectors and hyperwave transceivers designed to monitor and control traffic into and out of the Deep Core.

facts.text: As a fortress world, Byss was guarded by a number of security forces and technologies, all of which were overseen by Byss Security itself.

evidence.quote: As a fortress world, Byss was guarded by a number of security forces and technologies, all of which were overseen by Byss Security itself.

facts.text: The planet itself was surrounded by a planetary shield controlled by Byss Security, and a system of Gauntlet Scanner Stations were used to monitor traffic around the planet.

evidence.quote: The planet itself was surrounded by a planetary shield controlled by Byss Security, and a system of Gauntlet Scanner Stations were used to monitor traffic around the planet.

facts.text: Officers stationed aboard these platforms typically oversaw the daily operation of the Byss Security Zone by monitoring IFF transponder codes, security codes, and other forms of authorization used to control traffic to and from the surface of Byss.

evidence.quote: Officers stationed aboard these platforms typically oversaw the daily operation of the Byss Security Zone by monitoring IFF transponder codes, security codes, and other forms of authorization used to control traffic to and from the surface of Byss.

facts.text: On the surface of Byss, surveillance and a heavy military presence was commonplace.

evidence.quote: On the surface of Byss, surveillance and a heavy military presence was commonplace.
